notes.title: Message from Musynx about ranking
notes.content:
Some of the player lost their local score, We are very sorry for this.
We will update the game today and restore the local score in the following ways:
 
1 Music spectrum ranking score:
Please switch to your Music spectrum ranking and wait until the score is loaded. After the score of Music spectrum ranking is loaded, your local scores will be instantly Synchronized with the online Music spectrum ranking.
 
2. Total ranking score: 
Please restore all your Music spectrum ranking score first. After all the score is restored, choose a song to play. When you get a highest score, (you can accomplish this by playing a music that has never been played before), the total score will be recalculated and uploaded to the ranking list to update the ranking.
 
3 Notes: After today’s restoring, if some players suddenly get offline in the game, or other special circumstances let the score can not be uploaded to the rankings, local score will be temporarily recorded, but will be covered by the previous score when the network is connected, even if the local score are higher, will also be covered, So the score from offline will not be recorded, Please try to keep the network open while playing. Thank you.

notes.title: Future Update Teaser!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
 
We’d like to take a moment to once again thank you for your awesome support of MUSYNX on Steam! We’re so pleased that you are enjoying the game, and we’re always collecting and reviewing your helpful feedback for future updates to the game.
 
Speaking of updates, allow us to share some images of several new features coming soon to MUSYNX on Steam. We’ve heard your concerns that the current UI could be improved for PC screens, and so we’ve been working on a new version designed to take advantage of the extra space a large monitor offers. In addition, we’ve been creating some new and exciting animated backgrounds that we hope will enhance your MUSYNX experience!
 
These are just some of the changes you can expect to see in the future, and in the meantime we’ll be continuing to work on bugs and other requests from the community.
 
Also you can find us on twitter @MUSYNC_official or @ZdcInteractive

Enjoy!

Greetings!
 
Today we’ve rolled out the following updates to MUSYNX:
 
 
1.     Ranking system
 
There are two kinds of ranking:
A.    Music spectrum ranking, where each spectrum in the game has its own rank.
 
B.    Total ranking, showing the player's average score across all music spectrums.
(music that hasn’t been played will count as 0% in the rank)

Today we’ve rolled out the following updates to MUSYNX:

1. added a new song “Oriental Shade” to the Forever Friend pack

2. added two new modes: Low Spec Mode (for those with older computers) and High Spec Mode (for more powerful systems)

As always, please feel free to leave any feedback. We’ve heard your suggestions regarding Steam achievements and controller support: these features and more (Steam Trading Cards, for example) are coming soon!
